plugins.description: CS/AI academic search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and Crossref, with paper identity merging, bounded citation chains, and arXiv handoff.
Paper-reading mode with page and section anchors, structured reports, depth levels, and follow-up Q&A over the same parsed source.
Codex-style /btw that forks the current conversation into the native right sidebar.
Desktop notifications for completion, errors, and approval waits, fired only when you are away from the page.
Command Code plan quota card with 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows, reset countdowns, and billing-period usage.
Normalizes Pandoc-style $$ display-math blocks before Markdown parsing to prevent lost first lines and KaTeX errors.
